tested_scope: Observed result-state, effect-state, interface-treatment, and termination-gate claims only. Proposed controller synthesis/frontier items were not treated as measured mechanisms. No exploration-worker or feedback state was modified.

primary_sources.title: LocalLSTC: A Long Short-Term Control Architecture for Locally Deployed GUI Agents
Callability Is Not Operability: Controlled Interface Interventions for LLM Agents
Schema First Tool APIs for LLM Agents: A Controlled Study of Tool Misuse, Recovery, and Budgeted Performance
When May an Agent Stop? Evidence-Carrying Termination for Tool-Using LLMs

evidence: Primary abstract explicitly states Long-Term Control maintains active subgoal, subgoal-aligned evidence, and runtime feedback; Short-Term Execution realizes bounded commitments; L2S forms commitments and S2L integrates outcomes for progress, recovery, and termination.
Primary abstract reports Qwen3.6-27B overall SR-100 64.7% on OSWorld and 65.3% on WindowsAgentArena and says ablations support both sides of execution.
findings.scope_correction: The checkpoint's detailed Qwen3.5-9B OSWorld ablation values (49.1, 36.4, 41.5, Step Abstraction 31.6, individual 38.0/40.7/40.3/45.1/40.7/43.5, and runtime-event 34.3/18.8/11.8 etc.) were not exposed in the primary HTML/abstract surface available in this run. They remain source-attributed to the checkpoint but are not upgraded to independent primary verification here. The architectural state claim is verified; the exact detailed table remains the next raw/table-level verification target.

evidence: The paper explicitly holds task, backend, initial state, injected failure, controller/agent, model, and execution budget fixed while changing interface semantics; Table 2 says each pair changes only the targeted interface semantics.
Adaptive evaluation completed 18/18 model-workload cells with 2,385 result rows.

Primary pooled results: selective discovery about 4,013 fewer exposed context tokens while satisfying recall noninferiority; resumable invocation +100pp recovery; durable state +100pp recovery; effect-aware semantics -56.9pp duplicate effects; strong effect semantics -50.0pp unsafe commits; verification -27.8pp incorrect terminal claims.

The paper explicitly separates state distinction (authoritative evidence/verification) from continuation stabilization (idempotency/guarded effects), and reports recovery effects stable across model families while verification benefit is model-dependent.
findings.scope_correction: This is mechanism-level interface evidence under targeted matched faults, not the still-missing 2x2 in which an identical fixed agent-side recovery policy is independently toggled against operable-runtime ON/OFF. The paper's controller is held fixed within each interface pair; it does not independently factorialize the recovery policy as a second treatment axis.

findings.topic: Schema correctness versus semantic action quality
evidence: The reported pilot uses Qwen2.5-0.5B Instruct, seeds {0,1,2}, 3 interface conditions, budgets {3,5,8,12}, and an 8-task reduced pack.
The run produced 276 scored runs and 2,208 step records, with 12 additional runs excluded for infrastructure-related model timeouts.

Task success was 0.0 across every condition and budget; mean invalid calls were 5.39 for prose versus 3.72 for each schema condition; semantic misuse was 0.93 versus 3.03; execution failures 0.54 versus 0.00; invalid and semantic misuse counts rose monotonically with budget without success gains.
findings.scope_correction: The checkpoint's '276 scored runs' is correct, but the fully crossed nominal design implied by 8 tasks x 4 budgets x 3 conditions x 3 seeds is 288 attempted cells; the paper explicitly says 12 were excluded due to infrastructure timeouts. This remains a one-model, zero-success synthetic pilot and is evidence for separating contract adherence from semantic continuation quality, not for deployment success effects.

evidence: The verifier separates generation from authorization and binds COMPLETE to a trusted task descriptor, normalized ledger digest, valid in-scope receipts, exact allowed transforms, and deterministic replay; the paper explicitly limits soundness to the trusted contract/adapter and excludes external truth, authenticity, effects, safety, and alignment.

Fresh V2 primary scope: 0/66 premature unsupported terminations for ECT versus 40/66 for the faithful controller; supported completion 97/132 versus 92/132; ECT recovery 18/66, with 17 then completing with support; neither ECT nor controller falsely continued on 66 clean trajectories.

From the same table and zero clean false-continuation result, the checkpoint's incomplete-checkpoint supported-completion counts 31/66 for ECT and 26/66 for controller are consistent with 97-66 and 92-66 respectively; ECT therefore has 35/66 incomplete trajectories not completing within budget.

The manuscript directly reports paired all-primary-row overhead relative to controller: +0.90 decision turns, +4,653 tokens, +2.34 provider seconds, +USD 0.00246, and +0.045 tool calls per trajectory.

The reproducibility section states that a sanitized Apache-2.0 arXiv ancillary artifact contains frozen protocols, synthetic tasks, verifier/benchmark source, blinded static records, all 576 trajectory records, aggregate results, and deterministic replay instructions; it also states no independent third-party reproduction has been reported.
findings.scope_correction: The checkpoint's absolute incomplete-only means (~17,561.5 vs ~8,254.7 tokens, 7.96s vs 3.27s, USD 0.00888 vs 0.00396) are not printed in the manuscript text retrieved here. The manuscript independently verifies the direction and paired aggregate overhead, but those incomplete-only absolute means require ancillary-record replay or an explicit primary table; they are not marked independently recomputed in this audit. ECT is also a policy-pipeline comparison with independently sampled planner calls, not a same-proposal terminal-gate-only intervention.

cross_claim_synthesis.statement: The checkpoint's four-layer stack (runtime continuation guarantees -> effect-aligned persistent state -> conditional recovery -> terminal authorization) is a defensible synthesis of separate experiments, but no cited experiment jointly toggles or validates that entire stack. Keep AFT runtime guarantees, LocalLSTC GUI control state, Schema-First negative control, and ECT terminal authorization as separate evidence units.

unverified_or_unresolved: LocalLSTC detailed Qwen3.5-9B ablation/event table values require direct primary table/PDF/source or official artifact retrieval.

ECT incomplete-only absolute token/latency/cost means require deterministic replay of the arXiv ancillary 576-record artifact or an explicit primary table; only manuscript-level paired aggregate overhead was independently verified here.
The Agent-First Tool API economics contradiction from the checkpoint was not re-audited in this run because the four higher-priority effect-state/termination claims were addressed first.
